description: See live clocks for eight major world cities, plus any time zone you add yourself. Every clock updates each second, with your local date shown too.

faqs.a: The clocks use your browser's built-in time zone database (Intl.DateTimeFormat), so they handle daylight saving automatically and always reflect the current date.
faqs.q: Do the clocks handle daylight saving time?

faqs.a: Type an IANA time zone name such as America/Chicago or Asia/Karachi. If the name is not recognized, you will see a friendly error and nothing is added.
faqs.q: Which time zones can I add?

faqs.a: Yes — any custom time zones you add are saved in your browser, so they are still there the next time you open the tool on this device.

howto: Scroll to see the live clocks for the eight default cities.
Type a time zone name (e.g. America/Chicago) in the "Add your own" box.
Click "Add" to pin a new live clock for that zone.
Use the delete button on a custom clock to remove it.
title: World Clock
